about_the_game:
📌 Game Overview

Ashen Dungeon is a turn-based strategy RPG where players lead an expedition team to explore dungeons, gather resources, craft equipment, and engage in tactical battles against enemies.
The combat system combines the unpredictability of dice rolls with the strategic use of skills, offering a unique and engaging gameplay experience.

📜 Story & Worldbuilding

A world where hope has vanished.
Chaos reigns. On the day the sky turned crimson, order collapsed, and trust among people was replaced by fear.
For reasons unknown, the skin of all mortals began to harden, and in their panic, they turned against one another.
You must gather those who still hold the will to return to their former selves, lead an expedition, and carve a new destiny.
Every choice you make will shape your future.

⚔️ Gameplay Features

🛡️ Expedition Management – Recruit and grow your units to form a unique, customized expedition team.

🌀 Dungeon Exploration – Discover dangers and rewards as you delve into mysterious dungeons.

⛏️ Resource Gathering & Crafting – Secure your survival through lumbering, mining, and item crafting.

⚔️ Turn-Based Combat – Engage in unpredictable, dice-based tactical battles that demand strategic thinking.

💬 Development Intent & Background

Battle Brothers have deeply inspired me with their strategic depth and atmosphere.

As 1 person team, I’ve spent several years creating this game as a tribute to these exceptional title.

I will continue developing Ashen Dungeon to deliver its own unique and compelling experience, and I sincerely welcome your ongoing feedback and support.

content_descriptors.notes: Skeleton objects are placed in the scene, and damage occurs due to combat between characters and monsters. Although blood is not shown, petrified mortals can still meet their death.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.5 GHz / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 1050 / AMD RX550
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 2.8 GHz / AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 1080 / AMD RX 5600
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
